name: Seedcore
description: The core of New Phyrexia containing a miniature recreation of Elesh Norn's citadel and the root of the World Tree.

description_citations.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
description_citations.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tyvar spreads Glimmervoid metal over the entire group and Kaito lifts the oil so they can pass through the gateway safely.
timeline.quote: until his body was a Glimmervoid metal sculpture.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: They emerge in the Seedcore and see Realmbreaker, the corrupted World Tree, for the first time.
timeline.quote: Kaya turned and beheld the Phyrexian World Tree. Realmbreaker.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: A flash from the upper branches signals that the World Tree has connected to the Multiverse and the invasion has begun.
timeline.quote: The World Tree has connected to the Multiverse.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace collapses and Tyvar carries him into the tree's root cavity.
timeline.quote: scooped the other man into his arms

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The group finds Karn vivisected and bound at the center of the root chamber.
timeline.quote: The great silver golem had been broken open, vivisected, and spread across the platform.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Karn tells them the invasion is still young and that they must detonate the sylex at the root source.
timeline.quote: You will need to get to the root source and detonate it.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace volunteers to take the sylex, saying it is too late for him too, and heads for the doorway with Tyvar and Kaya.
timeline.quote: Let me take the Multiverse from them.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth and Melira stay behind to free Karn while Elspeth goes on, refusing to run any more.
timeline.quote: No more running.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The team sees the invasion ships being prepared and Phyrexians massing along gangways connected to the World Tree.
timeline.quote: Phyrexians shuffled along the gangways, readying their assault on the Multiverse.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Compleated Ajani and Tibalt approach on the bridge, with Ajani urging Elspeth to join Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: came Ajani and Tibalt, but not as they had known them.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth refuses to join Ajani, who invokes Phyrexia's promise of unity.
timeline.quote: All will be One.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tyvar confronts Tibalt and tells Kaito to take the others on to the root source.
timeline.quote: Elspeth and I will handle the vermin.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito, Kaya and Jace leave, and Elspeth and Tyvar begin their battle against Ajani and Tibalt.
timeline.quote: and the battle was joined.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace, Kaito and Kaya descend through the miniature citadel in the Seedcore, with Jace visibly being overtaken by wires.
timeline.quote: Jace didn't look good.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Kaya remark on the eerily sterile absence of spirits in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia didn't release its victims, not even in death.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Through a skylight they see the invasion ships filling with Phyrexian warriors.
timeline.quote: endless ranks of Phyrexian warriors in the red and white of Elesh Norn's faction filing into the increasingly gravid holds

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds a hole leading to a disk near Realmbreaker's trunk, and they drop down to the point nearest the root.
timeline.quote: This was as close as they were going to come to the core root of the tree.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace unpacks the sylex for the first time in Phyrexian air.
timeline.quote: He moved to unpack the sylex, revealing it to the Phyrexian air for the first time.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaya urges Jace to wait, warning the blast could travel through the Omenpaths to every connected plane.
timeline.quote: We could blow up the Blind Eternities.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace refuses to wait, saying Vraska is dead and he is dying and that the sylex must be detonated.
timeline.quote: Vraska is dead, and I am dying,

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaya grabs Jace's wrist and, with Kaito, draws a weapon against him to stop him.
timeline.quote: She pulled a dagger from her belt.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: On the bridge, Ajani urges Elspeth to join Phyrexia, then attacks her with his axe.
timeline.quote: You do not need to be alive to join Phyrexia.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tibalt taunts Tyvar as they fight with Tibalt's twin barbed tails.
timeline.quote: How does it feel to be the last prince of Kaldheim?

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tibalt's doubt overwhelms Elspeth, who is disarmed by Ajani and backs away.
timeline.quote: Ajani's next blow knocked the weapon from her hands

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaya discovers that the Jace she attacked is an illusion and that two of three Jaces are fakes.
timeline.quote: two of the Jaces didn't have spirits.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito hits Jace's arm with shuriken, dispelling the false images; Kaya moves on the sylex.
timeline.quote: Producing a handful of shuriken from inside his shirt, he flung them at the true Jace

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth's will returns, she blocks Ajani's blow, and Tyvar's magic suppresses Tibalt and the doubt he spreads.
timeline.quote: Your doubt can't touch what it can't reach.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth blasts Ajani back with white light and knocks him unconscious.
timeline.quote: driving him to the ground

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tyvar kills Tibalt by driving his own tail barbs through his chest and throwing him from the bridge, as Elspeth runs to find the others.
timeline.quote: Tyvar driving the twin barbs of Tibalt's tail into the space that should have held the Phyrexian's heart.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaya grabs what she thinks is the sylex, but it dissolves like mist because it was another of Jace's illusions.
timeline.quote: only for the sylex to dissolve in her hands like mist.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Hidden by illusion, Jace pours his grief, Mirrodin's agony and his love for Vraska into the sylex and speaks the words to activate it.
timeline.quote: Wipe the land clear. Bring the ending,

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth drops through the ceiling and runs Jace through with her sword, taking the sylex.
timeline.quote: she drove her blade through Jace and shoved him aside

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth vanishes with the activated sylex, bound for a point beyond the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: The sylex went with her, bound for some unknown destination, some point beyond the Blind Eternities.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Realmbreaker pulses and its branches wink out, carrying Phyrexian invaders through the Omenpaths to other planes.
timeline.quote: Each branch, with its heavy burden of Phyrexian invaders, had reached for another plane

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn enters with Phyrexian warriors, Tamiyo, and Jace's risen corpse, welcoming the survivors to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Welcome, weary travelers, to Phyrexia,

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Compleated Nahiri and Nissa are revealed beside Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: Nahiri had clearly not survived her fall.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The survivors refuse to yield, and Elesh Norn begins the invasion.
timeline.quote: and the invasion began.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

pages_say.description: The center of the plane where the sylex must be set off to destroy Realmbreaker.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

pages_say.description: The center of New Phyrexia where Realmbreaker is planted and Karn was imprisoned.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.
